//: The play screen: the map, the log and a status column. A profile names it for the roles `play` and `decision.free`. Its keys are in the keymap's `play` context and what they do is in controls.json; nothing here names a key. Other mods add to it through its two slots: `ui:play.bars` for a character's reserves and `ui:play.side` for anything else in the column.
title: Play

//: Look mode: a free cursor over the map, with what the party knows of the place under it, and a side panel with what the view model holds of that cell: the ground, as last seen, and every thing perceived there, named in the reader's terms. The `look` control opens it. The scene keeps the variables `cursor_sight`, `cursor_distance`, `cursor_target`, `cursor_things` and `cursor_ground` up to date for any screen that declares them; nothing here reads the world. Mods add to the panel through the slot `ui:look.side`.
title: Look

rows.text: {if screen.cursor_sight == 'seen' then 'In sight' else if screen.cursor_sight == 'remembered' then 'Remembered' else 'Not known'}, {screen.cursor_distance:.1} m away.

text.value: <title>Look</>  {if screen.cursor_target != '' then cap(screen.cursor_target) else 'Nobody there'}. {if screen.cursor_sight == 'seen' then 'In sight' else if screen.cursor_sight == 'remembered' then 'Remembered' else 'Not known'}, {screen.cursor_distance:.1} m away.
<dim>Direction keys move, Tab goes to the next thing, << and > change storey, Esc leaves.</>
